singapore-court-legal.title: MikeROS — Singapore Rules of Court 2021
singapore-court-legal.description: Singapore civil-procedure resolver (Rules of Court 2021): deterministically determines which ROC rule CONTROLS, the required procedural SEQUENCE, and whether a step is COMPLIANT — proof-carrying, and it abstains rather than guess (abstain-to-source where control passes to an uncompiled Practice Direction or Form). Returns rule citations + operator-verified case authorities where they attach. Use it to resolve a procedural position, not for interpretation, drafting, or strategy. Read-only; never fabricates a rule, sequence, or citation. API-key auth (CONNECTORS.md-accepted): supply your operator-issued MikeROS API key at connect time as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'.
